Huanglong

黄龙 - Travertine Terraces and Colorful Calcite Pools

Overview

Huanglong (Yellow Dragon) is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Sichuan Province, famous for its spectacular travertine terraces, colorful calcite pools, snow-capped peaks, and pristine forests. The scenic area is named after the Huanglong Gorge, where calcium carbonate deposits have created over 3,400 colorful pools in terraced formations spanning 3.6 kilometers. The pools shimmer in shades of blue, green, yellow, and white due to mineral deposits and algae. At an altitude of 3,000-3,600 meters, Huanglong is one of the highest scenic areas in China. The area is often combined with a visit to nearby Jiuzhaigou Valley (2-3 hours away).

Quick Facts

  • Location: Songpan County, Aba Prefecture, Sichuan Province
  • UNESCO Status: World Heritage Site since 1992
  • Altitude: 3,000 - 3,600 meters (high altitude)
  • Best Time to Visit: September-October (autumn colors, clear weather)
  • Entrance Fee: ¥170 (peak season Apr-Nov), ¥60 (off-season Dec-Mar)
  • Opening Hours: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM (varies by season)

🚗 How to Get There - Transportation

By Air to Jiuzhaigou

Jiuzhai Huanglong Airport: Flights from Chengdu (1h, ¥600-1000), Chongqing (1h, ¥800). Airport to Huanglong: 1.5h drive (taxi ¥200-300, or bus ¥50).

By Bus from Chengdu

From Chengdu: Bus to Songpan County (8-10h, ¥150-200). Then local bus or taxi to Huanglong (1h, ¥30-50). Long but scenic mountain road.

From Jiuzhaigou Valley

Distance: 2-3 hours drive between Jiuzhaigou and Huanglong. Many tourists visit both. Tour buses available (¥100-150 one way). Or private car (¥300-400).

Within Scenic Area

Cable Car: From entrance to upper area (¥80 one way, ¥40 return). Saves 2-3 hours of steep hiking. Highly recommended due to high altitude.

️ Recommended Tour Routes

Route 1: Classic One-Day Tour

Route: Cable car up → Five Color Pond (top) → Walk down through terraces → Huanglong Temple → Exit
Duration: 4-6 hours
Best for: First-time visitors, most popular route

Route 2: Full Hiking Route

Route: Walk up from entrance → Through forest → All terrace pools → Five Color Pond → Cable car down
Duration: 6-8 hours
Best for: Fit hikers, nature lovers (very strenuous at high altitude)

Route 3: Huanglong + Jiuzhaigou (2-3 Days)

Day 1: Huanglong full day
Day 2-3: Jiuzhaigou Valley (nearby)
Best for: Complete natural scenery experience

Route 4: Photography Special

Best Spots: Five Color Pond (morning light), Travertine terraces (midday), Forest pools (afternoon)
Tips: Early arrival to avoid crowds; bring polarizing filter for water shots

💡 Essential Travel Tips

  • Altitude Sickness: Huanglong is at 3,000-3,600m - HIGH ALTITUDE. Acclimatize in Chengdu (500m) first. Take it slow, stay hydrated, avoid alcohol. Consider altitude medication (Diamox).
  • Best Season: September-October for autumn colors and clear weather. Summer (Jun-Aug) is rainy but accessible. Winter (Nov-Mar) very cold, some areas closed.
  • Cable Car: Highly recommended due to altitude. Saves 2-3 hours of steep uphill hiking. ¥80 one way up.
  • Physical Fitness: Even with cable car, expect 2-3 hours of walking at high altitude. Not for those with heart/respiratory conditions.
  • Weather: Mountain weather changes rapidly. Bring warm layers, rain gear, sun protection. Can be cold even in summer at high altitude.
  • Combine with Jiuzhaigou: Most visitors do both (2-3h apart). Plan 3-4 days total for both areas.
  • Food: Limited options near Huanglong. Bring snacks and water. Restaurants at entrance are basic.
  • Photography: Best light morning and late afternoon. Five Color Pond most photogenic. Bring polarizing filter.
  • Crowds: Peak season (Oct) extremely crowded. Arrive early morning. Avoid Chinese holidays.
  • Payment: WeChat Pay and Alipay accepted. ATMs limited - bring cash from Chengdu.
